title_en: Seon-joo Jeong, President of the Korean Society of Integrative Biology, “We will continue to maintain the late Professor Wan-gyu Cho.”
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] "We have prepared a special symposium to commemorate Professor Wan-gyu Cho of Seollang, who passed away last month. We will continue the spirit of free academic discussion, research cooperation, and nurturing future generations that he always emphasized." Recently, a special symposium to commemorate Professor Wan-gyu Cho was held in conjunction with the Seollang Symposium, which celebrated its 38th anniversary, at the Buyeo Resort in South Chungcheong Province from the 21st to the 23rd. The Seollang Symposium, created 38 years ago, has continued its tradition as a venue for academic exchange and cooperation among domestic life science researchers. Jeong Seon-joo, president of the Korean Society for Integrative Biology (Professor at Dankook University), said, "The Seollang Symposium is a valuable academic tradition that has grown together with domestic life science researchers over the past 38 years. We will inherit the academic legacy and research spirit left by Minister Wan-gyu Cho and develop it into a venue where future generations of researchers can continue new collaborations and challenges." Chairman Jeong also said. He added, “We will continue to strive to ensure that the Seollang Symposium continues as a venue for academic exchanges and communication between researchers across generations.” At this symposium, researchers and students from universities, research institutes, and medical institutions across the country attended to share the latest research results in the fields of cell biology and biomedical sciences and continued active discussions. title_source: 삼성SDS, AI 인프라부터 에이전트까지…'풀스택 AI' 성과 가시화
summary_source: [지디넷코리아]삼성SDS가 2분기에도 안정적인 성장세를 이어갔다. 특히 인공지능(AI) 인프라와 AI 전환(AX), 생성형 AI 플랫폼으로 이어지는 이른바 'AI 풀스택' 전략이 본격적으로 성과를 내기 시작했다는 점이 주목된다.삼성SDS는 30일 2분기 잠정실적을 발표하고 매출 3조7천178억원, 영업이익 2천318억원을 기록했다고 밝혔다. 전년 동기 대비 매출은 5.9%, 영업이익은 0.7% 증가했다.사업별로는 IT서비스 부문 매출이 1조7천625억원으로 전년 동기 대비 5% 늘었고, 물류 사업 매출은 1조9천553억원으로 6.6% 증가했다.삼성SDS의 2분기 성장세를 이끈 핵심은 클라우드 사업이었다. 클라우드 매출은 7천794억원으로 전년 동기 대비 17% 증가했으며, 특히 대외 사업 매출이 75% 급증하며 IT서비스 부문 실적 개선을 주도했다.세부적으로는 삼성 클라우드 플랫폼(SCP) 수요 확대와 공공·민간 GPUaaS 사업 증가에 힘입어 CSP 사업이 전년 대비 24% 성장했다. 금융권 AX 사업과 조선업 ERP 프로젝트 확대 영향으로 MSP 사업도 17% 증가하며 성장세를 이어갔다.삼성SDS는 클라우드 사업과 함께 AI 인프라 사업도 확대하고 있다…

title_en: Samsung SDS, from AI infrastructure to agents... ‘Full-stack AI’ performance visualization
summary_en: [GD Net Korea] Samsung SDS continued its stable growth in the second quarter. summary_ja: 「G-DINET Korea」は、AiMaticsが国土安全管理院忠清地域本部業務用車両の安全な運行を支援する。今回の条約は、国土安全管理員職員が使用する業務用車両の事故を先制的に予防し、データマスキングや映像自動ブラー処理など個人情報保護が重要な業務用車両環境に合わせたAI安全管理システムを構築するために推進された。 AIカメラは走行中の車両内外の危険状況をリアルタイムで検知して運転者に即座に警告を送り、管理者は該当プラットフォームが提供するスコアリングレポートと安全運転統計で運転者の危険運転パターンを分析して改善点を見つけることができる。また、事故や緊急状況で映像確保が必要なときは、PCやモバイルアプリで遠隔でも映像をすぐに確認することができる。
title_en: AImatics helps the Chungcheon National Land Safety Management Agency ensure safe driving of business vehicles
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] AImatics helps the safe operation of business vehicles at the Chungcheong Regional Headquarters of the Korea Land Safety and Security Administration. AImatics announced on the 30th that it signed a business agreement (MOU) with the Chungcheong Regional Headquarters of the Korea Land Safety and Security Administration. This agreement was promoted to preemptively prevent accidents in business vehicles used by National Land Safety Management Agency employees and to establish an AI safety management system tailored to the business vehicle environment where personal information protection is important, such as data masking and automatic image blur processing. The solution provided by AImatics consists of an on-device AI camera for vehicles and a safe driving platform. The AI ​​camera detects dangerous situations inside and outside the vehicle while driving in real time and immediately sends a warning to the driver, and managers can find areas for improvement by analyzing the driver's risky driving patterns using the scoring report and safe driving statistics provided by the platform. In addition, when you need to secure video due to an accident or emergency situation, you can immediately check the video remotely using a PC or mobile app. Lee Hoon, CEO of AImatics, said, "The biggest issue in vehicle management for public institutions and companies recently is the balance between ensuring safety and protecting personal information."
